Message:
KVM: VMX: remove unneeded vmx_load_host_state() calls.

vmx_load_host_state() does not handle msrs switching (except
MSR_KERNEL_GS_BASE) since commit 26bb0981b3f. Remove call to it
where it is no longer make sense.
